Ran a full isolated empty-database migration cycle as required evidence for AC1: spun up a brand-new, never-before-used Postgres 16 container (memories-migration-check-0004, since removed) rather than reusing the shared memories-test-postgres container (which already had prior migration/seed history and would not prove a true empty-database apply-all-four). Applied all 4 migrations, seeded (twice, to reconfirm seed idempotency), ran the full e2e suite (77/77 passing), reverted all 4 catalog migrations one at a time via migration:revert (verified back to the 5-migration pre-existing baseline via migration:show), reapplied all 4 via migration:run, reseeded, and reran the full e2e suite a second time (77/77 again). Container removed after the run; no lasting infra change.

Review-cycle-7 finding #2 (stale UI-fidelity evidence): root-caused the 4 flagged gift background-refresh/dialog captures showing 'Chưa có ảnh' to the capture script's apiUrl default (http://localhost:3000) no longer matching the frontend's real configured backend (http://localhost:3010, per apps/public-web/.env.local) — an unrelated process from a different project (lms-backend admin-bff) was squatting port 3000, so any run using the default silently hit the wrong (or no) backend. The capture script already had an assertRepresentativeProductSeed() precondition (added in review cycle 5) meant to catch exactly this, but it had apparently never actually been run against the real target since the port moved. Fixed by discovering/restarting the real dev servers (apps/api on :3010, apps/public-web on :3100 — the latter's existing process was returning 500s and had to be restarted) and rerunning the capture script with FRONTEND_URL/API_URL explicitly set, rather than editing the script's default (out of scope for an evidence-only fix; documented as a testing.md pitfall instead).
